<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def btok(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'bS' and 4<=n['pixels']<=40:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)>=15:  # only bottom token (inside middle block)
                out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print('start:', btok(current_frame))
for i in range(5):
    action(['UP'], intent='explore')
    print(f'UP{i+1}:', btok(current_frame), 'no_impact',last_action_result.get('no_impact'),'done',last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def btok(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'bS' and 4<=n['pixels']<=40:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)>=15:  # only bottom token (inside middle block)
                out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
